add_na_indicator: add NA indicator columns to a pandas DataFrame and replace missing values with defaults
drop_na_rows: drop rows containing NA values from a pandas DataFrame and corresponding weight series
quantize: quantize numeric columns in a pandas DataFrame into equal-frequency interval bins
auto_spread: spread key-value pairs in a pandas DataFrame into separate columns per key group
fct_lump: lump rare categories in a pandas Series below a threshold into a single other category
